description:
About the Role

HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions) is Hopper’s B2B division, powering travel AI solutions across leading airlines, hotels and financial institutions globally. The Marketing & Communications team is looking for a Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager to lead growth marketing for its B2B business across digital channels. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the expectation is that the candidate handles both strategy and execution.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the B2B digital marketing strategy for HTS, setting channel priorities, budgets, and targets tied to pipeline and revenue

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Ads, and other digital channels, from audience and creative through to reporting

  • Build and run lead generation programs end to end, working with Sales to define lead quality and keep improving it

  • Own paid LinkedIn as a core B2B channel, running Sponsored Content, Lead Gen Forms, and ABM-style audience targeting to reach senior decision-makers at airlines, hotels, and financial institutions, and continuously testing creative and formats to improve lead quality

  • Develop content for digital campaigns, including social content, search ads, and more

  • A/B test content and ad formats to optimize for lead generation and conversion

  • Test and scale new channels and tactics, and know when to cut what isn’t working

  • Track, analyze, and report on performance, including cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution, and turn the data into clear recommendations for the team

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Legal, and Communications to keep messaging consistent and campaigns aligned with business priorities

  • Drive quality over quantity, optimizing campaigns for sales-qualified leads (SQLs) rather than raw lead volume, and working with Sales to continuously refine targeting, messaging, and lead criteria so that marketing effort translates into real pipeline

  • Work closely with the Marketing & Communications team while operating with a high degree of independence

  • Report on digital performance to senior leadership, translating channel metrics like cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution into clear insights and recommendations that inform marketing investment and strategy

  • Work with sales, leadership and marketing comms to create strategy and process for tracking marketing leads through the entire sales pipeline

  • Provide comprehensive insights on how marketing campaigns influenced pipeline progression and revenue

  • Develop and scale marketing activations onsite at industry and owned events

  • Potential to support growth within existing partners over time, through expansion campaigns and joint product launches with partner teams and Comms

An ideal candidate has

  • 5+ years of proven experience running B2B digital marketing programs, with clear examples of taking a campaign from inception to leads that Sales accepted and considered qualified

  • Hands-on expertise in LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, with strong command of targeting, bidding, creative testing, and optimization

  • Proficiency in HubSpot, Salesforce, and GA4, with the ability to manage lead flow, attribution, and performance reporting across the full funnel

  • Comfort working at both levels: you can set the strategy and also build, launch, manage, optimize, and report on the campaigns yourself

  • Strong analytical skills and fluency in reporting tools, CRM, and marketing automation platforms

  • A self-starter mindset, with the ability to prioritize, manage your own workload, and deliver without close oversight

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across teams and with senior stakeholders

  • Experience in tech, travel, or B2B environments is a strong asset

  • Comfort in a lean, senior team where ownership is broad and no task is beneath you

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan

  • Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage

  • HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses

  • All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere

  • All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same.

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

  • Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked

  • Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again

  • HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled

  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal

Come take off with us!

#LI-Remote

At Hopper, we use AI-assisted tools to help our team review applications more efficiently. These tools screen and prioritize applications against the qualifications and experience listed in this posting. They do not make decisions: every decision about your application is made by a member of the Hopper team. For details on how we process candidate data and your rights, see our Candidate Privacy Notice.
